## The recordings

- **mmj2017-07-14.mk4.flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 22 songs; 140 min [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2017-07-14.mk4.flac24**: taped by Innis (innisn at gmail); transferred by Innis (innisn at gmail); source: mk4 > kc5 > cmc6 > m248 > mme > hdp2 (24/96) [1]
- **mmj2017-07-14.mk4.flac16**: taped by Innis (innisn at gmail); source: mk4 > kc5 > cmc6 > m248 > mme > hdp2 (24/96) [2]
- **mmj2017-07-14**: taped by Alex Leary; transferred by Alex Leary; source: DPA 4023 > Sound Devices MixPre-6 (24/48) [3]
- **mmj2017-07-14.CM33**: taped by opsopcopolis; transferred by opsopcopolis; source: AUD [4]
